title: Edmonton Indigenous Heritage Private Tour
blurb: This is more than a sightseeing tour — it’s a respectful journey into Indigenous stories, history, and land. You’ll experience Alberta through Indigenous eyes: from a scenic drive across Treaty 6 territory to one of Canada’s most immersive cultural exhibits. Along the way, you’ll meet local storytellers, see meaningful artwork, and explore how Indigenous Peoples continue to shape this land with pride, resilience, and beauty. No other experience like this is offered through major global travel platforms.
